title: Sandtrap Escape | KEY.co
description_expanded: The private backyard is designed for relaxation and entertainment, featuring a resort-style pool, hot tub, outdoor kitchen, and inviting lounge areas ideal for sunny afternoons and evening gatherings. Multiple balconies provide peaceful spaces to unwind, while the top-level game room with a pool table and wet bar offers the perfect setting for entertainment. An elevator adds convenience across all levels, and six adult bikes make it easy to explore the surrounding coastal roads, shops, and dining. With thoughtfully designed bedrooms, spacious gathering areas, and exceptional amenities, this Miramar Beach getaway offers a refined and memorable coastal escape. Located in the vibrant coastal community of Miramar Beach, this elegant retreat blends modern luxury with the relaxed charm of the Gulf Coast. Just a short walk from beach access, the home offers beautifully designed living spaces filled with natural light and stylish finishes. The open-concept main level features a spacious living area with a contemporary fireplace, a chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a gas range, and a large dining space perfect for gathering. Expansive sliding doors lead to the outdoor oasis, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and resort-style outdoor living.
